quick_skim.title: Teacher-Free Self-Distilled Consistency Trajectory Learning for Fast Speech Enhancement
quick_skim.abstract: Consistency trajectory models offer a route to fast, high-quality speech enhancement, collapsing the many reverse steps of diffusion-based enhancers into a handful. When instantiated on a Schrödinger bridge (SB), which pins the generative process to fixed clean and noisy endpoints, existing consistency-trajectory enhancers (SBCTMs) still require a pretrained teacher to supply trajectory supervision, which raises training cost and ties the final quality to that of the teacher. We propose a teacher-free, self-distilled consistency-trajectory framework that removes the external teacher: trajectory targets are generated by an exponential-moving-average (EMA) copy of the student, and the model is trained with a three-stage curriculum of $\x_0$ prediction, a self-distilled shortcut objective, and perceptual fine-tuning with a multi-resolution short-time Fourier transform (MR-STFT) loss. Using the same NCSN++ backbone as SBCTM, our model attains a wide-band PESQ of $3.01$, ESTOI $0.87$, and SI-SDR $19.07$\,dB on VoiceBank+DEMAND without a teacher. Varying step count and inference schedule we find that a geometric schedule at low reverse step count maximizes perceptual quality, while a higher-step uniform schedule favors signal fidelity, with the geometric advantage narrowing with reverse step count.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: Proposes a teacher-free self-distilled consistency trajectory framework for speech enhancement on Schrödinger bridge, removing the pretrained teacher by using an EMA copy of the student to generate trajectory targets, enabling fast and efficient generative modeling.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 该论文针对基于薛定谔桥的语音增强一致性轨迹模型仍需预训练教师提供轨迹监督、训练成本高且质量受教师限制的问题，提出了一种无教师自蒸馏的一致性轨迹学习框架。方法利用学生模型的指数移动平均副本生成轨迹目标，并采用三阶段课程训练，从而去除外部教师。该框架在语音增强任务上实现了快速生成，同时降低了训练开销并摆脱了对教师质量的依赖，为薛定谔桥在生成建模中的高效应用提供了新方案。
